title: Evaluation of the Safety and Efficacy of Long-term Use of Omega-3 Fatty Acid Ethyl Esters
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of long-term use of granular capsule formulation of omega-3 fatty acid ethyl esters (Lotriga Granular Capsules) in patients with hyperlipidemia in daily medical practice
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hyperlipidemia

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with hemorrhage (e.g., hemophilia, capillary fragility, gastrointestinal ulcer, urinary tract hemorrhage, hemoptysis, or vitreous hemorrhage)
2. Patients with a history of hypersensitivity to ingredients in granular capsule formulation of omega-3 fatty acid ethyl esters
